item.text: I’m extending the same kind of cleanup, but I’m going to keep it surgical: look for a few more high-duplication utility methods in `base`, then extract private helpers where it genuinely reduces repetition without changing semantics.

I’m not going broad across all of `base`; I’m checking classes that already have obvious mirrored logic. `Ascii` and `CaseFormat` are the best candidates so far because they both have repeated string transformation patterns that can be collapsed into helpers without touching behavior.

`Ascii` has the same kind of duplication pattern as `Strings`: mirrored string transforms with two nearly identical code paths. I’m going to collapse the upper/lower case string logic into one private helper and keep the `CharSequence` fast path intact.

I found one more low-risk cleanup in `MoreObjects`: the `Object` and `Class` overloads can route through the existing `String` overload instead of each constructing the helper directly. It’s small, but it removes another bit of near-duplicate structure in a central utility class.
The first `Ascii` patch missed the exact file tail, so I’m re-reading the end of the class and applying a narrower patch. No design change, just correcting the patch context.

item.text:
Extended the refactor to two more core utility classes in both source trees.

- `Ascii` now routes all string/char-sequence/char case conversion through shared private helpers, removing duplicated lower/upper-case loops: [guava `Ascii.java`]( /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/base/Ascii.java#L407 ), [android `Ascii.java`]( /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/android/guava/src/com/google/common/base/Ascii.java#L407 ).
- `MoreObjects.toStringHelper(Object)` and `toStringHelper(Class<?>)` now delegate to the existing `String` overload instead of constructing `ToStringHelper` directly, which keeps the overload set flatter and easier to maintain: [guava `MoreObjects.java`]( /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/guava/src/com/google/common/base/MoreObjects.java#L115 ), [android `MoreObjects.java`]( /Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G003_guava/android/guava/src/com/google/common/base/MoreObjects.java#L112 ).
